lines.zh: 我从祭坛的影子里飞出来。
lines.en: I fly out of the altar's shadow.

lines.zh: 翅膀是黑雾做的，没有声音。
lines.en: My wings are black mist and make no sound.

lines.zh: 我沿着墙飞一圈，贴着顶。
lines.en: I fly a circuit along the wall, close to the ceiling.
The crystal blood still clings to me.
I pass the candle, and it doesn't flicker.
I can't see the way, and I don't need to.

lines.zh: 我从梁下掠过，抖落一点黑。
lines.en: I slip under the beam, shedding a little darkness.
I wheel around that pillar.
The air runs low beneath me.
I'm behind you, and you haven't noticed.

lines.zh: 我贴着黑暗飞，像一道裂缝。
lines.en: I fly along the darkness like a crack.

lines.zh: 我上升，最后停在房梁下。
lines.en: I rise and settle under the rafter.
I skirt the window; the light is too bright.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀边缘在慢慢散开。
lines.en: The edges of my wings are slowly fraying.

lines.zh: 我滑过地面，影子掠过石砖。
lines.en: I glide over the floor, my shadow racing the tiles.

lines.zh: 我转向，一点声音也没有。
lines.en: I change direction without a sound.
I hang in the shadow and stay still.
My wings fold in slowly.

lines.zh: 我听见血在别人身体里走。
lines.en: I hear blood moving in someone else's body.
The light here bothers me.
I twitch my ears, very softly.

lines.zh: 黑色的雾从我身上散下来。
lines.en: Black mist drifts off me.
Hanging from the beam, I count heads.
Shadow is my bed.

lines.zh: 祭坛的血一干，我就醒了。
lines.en: The altar blood dried and I woke.
That stone is still glowing.
I hang there like a scrap of cloth.
I wait for nightfall.
You're looking at me — I can tell.
I stop just above your head.
Your blood smells good.
Don't swat; I'll dodge.
I'm in the shadow on your shoulder.
Raise a torch and I retreat.

lines.zh: 我在你领口的上方停住
lines.en: I hover above the collar of your shirt.
Did you hear something?
You won't remember my shape.
Look a moment longer, and I'll go.
I scatter and re-form.
That thinned me out.
A layer of my mist is gone.
I lose part of a wing.
It hurts, though not quite like pain.
I retreat into the shadow.

lines.zh: 雾里破了个洞，慢慢补上
lines.en: A hole tears in my mist and slowly closes.
I shudder and pull my mist back in.
You hit the solid part of me.
I go quiet for a while.
That drop of blood wakes me a while.
The crystal's taste is in the air.
I circle it twice.
I don't eat ordinary things.
Give it to me and I'll come close.
Don't think you can keep me fed.
I hover above your wrist.
That smell sharpens me.
I put out my tongue; it's thin.

lines.zh: 祭坛上那点结晶血，是我的。
lines.en: That crystal blood on the altar is mine.

lines.zh: 我撞上你，散成雾又合起来。
lines.en: I hit you and scatter into mist, then reform.
You passed through part of me.
My wing brushed your face.
Don't grab; I can't be held.
I loop around you once.
You have no weight, and neither do I.
You pass through me and shiver.
I pull back against the wall.
Your torch singed me.
That collision doesn't count.

lines.zh: 祭坛上的两只影子靠近了。
lines.en: Two shadows on the altar draw near.
We form a circle.
The black mist joins, then parts.
I hear her wings.
In this dark there's only us.
We have no body heat.
There will be more shadows after this.
She flies off first, and I follow.
This sort of thing needs no light.
Don't light a lamp; it breaks the spell.
I hook it with my claws.

lines.zh: 它穿过我的身体，掉下去。
lines.en: It passes through my body and falls.
I hold it in my mouth and taste nothing.
I can carry this much.
I hide it up on the beam.
I fly it across half the hall.
Holding this, I fly crooked.
I open my claws and it drops.
I push it into the shadow.

lines.zh: 这玩意儿压不住我的雾。
lines.en: This thing won't hold my mist.
You stepped on the edge of the altar.

lines.zh: 你的影子被我钉在地上
lines.en: I pin your shadow to the floor.
Blood pulses in that leg.
I dive at you.
I am just past the circle of torchlight.
I come from above.
Turning won't help.
I've waited for this bite.
Something moves in the shadow.
You're marked.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的影子的边缘飞
lines.en: I fly along the edge of your shadow.
Black mist covers your eyes.
I sweep past your back.
Your hand comes up too slowly.
I close another foot.

lines.zh: 我把你的影子一口口吃掉
lines.en: I eat your shadow bite by bite.
My wing grazes your ear.
I'm waiting for your torch to die.

lines.zh: 你的气息一抖，我跟上去
lines.en: Your breath falters, and I close in.
This time I aim for the neck.
I bite your shoulder, cold.
My claws leave a dark streak.

lines.zh: 我撞进你的胸口，又穿出。
lines.en: I plunge into your chest and out again.
The chill drives you back.
I scatter into mist and reform on the other side.
My teeth are fine and many.
That one didn't land.
Your hand passed through my head.
I cling back to the wall.
Blood drips onto the altar.
The crystal blood on the altar lights up.
I form out of the black mist.
The wings open first, then the rest of me.

lines.zh: 这间屋子的光暗了一半。
lines.en: Half the light in this room went out.
I take flight and circle the altar.
The summoning is done, and I'm awake.
There's a faint smell of blood in the air.
I settle on the beam, hanging upside down.
I cry out, and no one hears.
I was called, so I came.

lines.zh: 火把我的雾烧穿了，我缩成一团。
lines.en: Fire burns through my mist and I curl small.

lines.zh: 我从梁上掉下来，散了一半。
lines.en: I drop from the beam and half of me scatters.

lines.zh: 水灌进雾里，我变得又重又沉。
lines.en: Water soaks my mist and I turn heavy.
The blast scatters me entirely.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我，留下一个空洞。
lines.en: An arrow passes through and leaves a hole.

lines.zh: 那股法力把我钉在墙上。
lines.en: That magic pins me to the wall.

lines.zh: 太久没喝血，我薄得透光。
lines.en: Too long without blood; I'm thin enough to see through.

lines.zh: 雷光把我照得几乎消失。
lines.en: The lightning flash nearly erases me.
No shadows left; there's nowhere for me to cling.
